label: Distinct Clinico-pathogenic Subgroups in Pediatric Lyme Neuroborreliosis.
summary: Lyme neuroborreliosis (LNB) is a common manifestation of Lyme disease in children. It is caused by the bacterium We performed a large retrospective cohort study of children diagnosed with LNB at the University Children's Hospital Zurich from 1 January 2006 to 31 December 2020. A total of 190 children diagnosed with LNB were included (median age, 7.6 years).
